y-m-21-05.title: Ake sihlele ukuthi yiziphi izimo ezingaba yi-regular polyhedra
y-m-21-05.goal: Usebenzisa isimo sokuthi isamba sama-engeli azungeze i-vertex kumele sibe sincane kuno-360°, thola wonke (isimo sobuso, inani lobuso obuhlangana) ngaphandle kokushiya lutho, bese uhlukanisa ukuthi lesi simo siyisimo esidingekayo noma esanelisayo.
y-m-21-05.material: I-regular polyhedron iyisimo esiqinile esiphumelelayo esinobuso bonke buyi-regular polygons efanayo futhi lapho inani elifanayo lobuso lihlangana ku-vertex ngayinye. UJiyun ufuna ukuthola ukuthi angenza yini i-regular polyhedron ngokuqoqa ubuso obungu-q obuyi-regular polygons enezinhlangothi ezingu-p ku-vertex ngayinye. Biza isamba se-engeli yangaphakathi eyodwa ye-regular p-gon ngayinye eqoqwe ku-vertex eyodwa 'isamba sama-engeli azungeze i-vertex'. Ukuze i-vertex ibukeke njengesiqinile, lesi samba kumele sibe sincane kuno-360° (uma singu-360° siba yisicaba, futhi uma sikhulu kuno-360° asikwazi ukugoqeka). Ubuso obungu-3 okungenani buhlangana ku-vertex eyodwa. I-engeli yangaphakathi eyodwa ye-regular p-gon ingu-180°×(p−2)÷p.

y-m-21-02.title: Izindlela ezimbili zokuthola isamu lama-engeli angaphakathi, kodwa izimpendulo ziyahluka?
y-m-21-02.goal: Uma amasamu ama-engeli angaphakathi atholwe ngezindlela ezimbili ezihlukile ehluka, nquma ukuthi iphutha lenzeke esinyathelweni sini, futhi usebenzise umphumela ukuthola ama-polygon ajwayelekile ane-engeli eyodwa engaphakathi eyinombolo yemvelo.
y-m-21-02.material: Abantu ababili bathole isamu lama-engeli angaphakathi e-pentagon eyi-convex (i-pentagon lapho wonke ama-engeli angaphakathi engaphansi kuka-180°) usebenzisa izindlela ezihlukile. UHarin: Wadweba wonke ama-diagonal kusuka ku-vertex eyodwa aya kwamanye ama-vertex, ehlukanisa i-pentagon ibe onxantathu abangu-3, futhi wathi 180°×3=540°. UDoyun: Wamaka iphoyinti elilodwa ngaphakathi kwe-pentagon futhi walixhuma kuwo wonke ama-vertex amahlanu, ethola onxantathu abangu-5, futhi wathi 180°×5=900°. Iyi-pentagon efanayo, kodwa izimpendulo ziyahluka. (Isamu lama-engeli amathathu angaphakathi kanxantathu lingu-180°.)

y-m-21-01.title: Uma ama-engeli alingana uma ekalwa, imigqa emibili iyafana yini?
y-m-21-01.goal: Hlukanisa ukuthi inani le-engeli elikalwe ngqo nomkhawulo onikeziwe enkingeni kuxhasa kanjani ngokwehlukile isinqumo sokulingana kwemigqa, futhi ulungise isinqumo sakho noma ukuzethemba kwakho njengoba kufika ulwazi olusha.
y-m-21-01.material: Umugqa n uhlangana nemigqa emibili l no-m. Emaphoyinteni amabili ahlukile P no-Q ku-n, umugqa n uhlangana no-l no-m ngokulandelana, futhi ibanga phakathi kuka-P no-Q lingu-6cm (P ingaphezulu, Q ingaphansi). Vumela ∠a (i-engeli a) ibe i-engeli ku-P eseduze kwesokudla ngaphezulu ku-n, no-∠b (i-engeli b) ibe i-engeli ku-Q endaweni efanayo, kwesokudla ngaphezulu ku-n. La ma-engeli amabili ama-engeli ahambisanayo. UJiho ufuna ukwazi ukuthi imigqa l no-m iyafana yini. Ukulingana kusho ukuthi ayihlangani nanini noma ungayelula kangakanani. (Ayikho umdwebo, ngakho dweba ekhanda lakho noma ephepheni njengoba kuchaziwe ngenhla.)

y-m-21-03.title: Uma i-engeli esembindini iba izikhathi ezingu-3 ngobukhulu, i-chord nayo iba izikhathi ezingu-3 ngobude?
y-m-21-03.goal: Thola umugqa ophosile esixazululweni esisebenzise isakhiwo sokuthi ubude be-arc buhambisana ngokuqondile nengeli esembindini nakuma-chord, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi ubude be-chord abuhambisani ngokuqondile usebenzisa amacala ama-engeli asembindini angu-180° no-120°.
y-m-21-03.material: Kunendilinga u-O enomsebe ongu-6cm. Emaphoyintini u-A, B, C endilingeni, u-∠AOB=60° no-∠AOC=180°. I-chord ngumugqa oxhuma amaphoyinti amabili endilingeni. USeoyun waxazulula kanje ukuthola ubude be-chord u-AC. Okwaziwa kakade: Ku-sector, ubude be-arc buhambisana ngokuqondile nosayizi we-engeli esembindini. (Unxantathu u-OAB uyunxantathu olinganayo wonke izinhlangothi ezintathu zingu-6cm, ngakho i-chord u-AB=6cm.)
y-m-21-03.thinking.1: Hlulela ububanzi lapho isakhiwo sisebenza khona

y-m-21-03.prereq.1: Isakhiwo sokuthi ubude be-arc buhambisana ngokuqondile nosayizi we-engeli esembindini

y-m-21-03.s.s1.explain: Umugqa 3 uphosile. Ubude be-arc buhambisana ngokuqondile nosayizi we-engeli esembindini, kodwa ubude be-chord abuhambisani. U-18cm emgqeni 4 uyinani elivela emgqeni ophosile 3 (uma ukhethe umugqa 4, uthole ukuthi umphumela uphosile, kodwa imbangela ngumugqa 3).
y-m-21-03.s.s2.prompt: Iyiphi indlela eqondile kakhulu yokuqinisekisa ukuthi umphumela kaSeoyun ongu-18cm uphosile? (Cabanga nge-chord u-AC ene-∠AOC=180°.)
y-m-21-03.s.s2.hint.0: Dweba ukuthi amaphoyinti amathathu u-A, O, C abekwe kanjani uma u-∠AOC=180°.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.hint.1: Bese uveza ubude buka-AC ngqo usebenzisa umsebe futhi uqhathanise nenani likaSeoyun.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.o.a: Umjikelezo wendilinga ungu-12π cm (37.7cm cishe), ngakho u-18cm mfushane kunomjikelezo futhi liyinani elingenzeka
y-m-21-03.s.s2.r.a: Uqhathanise ubude be-chord nomjikelezo wendilinga. Cabanga ukuthi lobo bude obufanele ukuqhathanisa i-chord nabo yini.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.o.b: Kwakungu-6cm ku-60°, ngakho ku-180° u-6×3=18cm ulungile, futhi ngizohlola ukubala kanye futhi
y-m-21-03.s.s2.r.b: Uhlole kuphela ukubala ngombono ofanayo wokuhambisana. Hlola umbono wokuhambisana uqobo.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.o.c: Uma u-∠AOC=180°, u-AC uyidayamitha edlula esikhungweni sendilinga futhi ingu-12cm, ngakho u-18cm mude kunalokho futhi akunakwenzeka
y-m-21-03.s.s2.r.c: Uhlole umphumela ngokugxila emumweni obalulekile we-engeli esembindini engu-180°.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.o.d: I-chord imfushane kune-arc yayo, ngakho uma iqhathaniswa nobude be-arc u-AC, 6π (18.8cm cishe), u-18cm liyinani elingenzeka futhi uSeoyun ulungile
y-m-21-03.s.s2.r.d: Kuyiqiniso ukuthi i-chord imfushane kune-arc yayo. Kodwa leli qhathaniso lodwa alikutsheli ukuthi u-18cm uphosile.
y-m-21-03.s.s2.explain: Uma i-engeli esembindini ingu-180°, i-chord u-AC iyidayamitha edlula esikhungweni u-O sendilinga, ngakho ubude bayo bungu-6+6=12cm. U-18cm mude kunalokho futhi akunakwenzeka. Indlela yokuqhathanisa ne-arc (d) isebenzisa isakhiwo esiyiqiniso kodwa ayibonisi ukuthi u-18cm uphosile.
y-m-21-03.s.s3.prompt: Cabanga nge-chord u-AD ene-engeli esembindini engu-120° (∠AOD=120°). Uma 'ubude be-chord nabo buhambisana ngokuqondile', kufanele bube yizikhathi ezingu-2 zalokho okungu-60°, 6×2=12cm. U-AD wangempela mude kuno-12cm, ufana, noma mfushane? Bhala ukuthi kungani ucabanga kanjalo.
y-m-21-03.s.s3.hint.0: Dweba unxantathu u-AOD oxhuma amaphoyinti amathathu u-A, O, D futhi ulinganise ubude bezinhlangothi zawo ezintathu.

y-m-21-03.s.s3.model.0: U-AD mfushane kuno-12cm. Kunxantathu u-AOD, OA+OD=6+6=12cm, futhi uhlangothi olulodwa lukanxantathu kumele lube lufushane kunesamu lezinye izinhlangothi ezimbili, ngakho u-AD mfushane kuno-12cm. Ngakho i-chord ayihambisani ngokuqondile ne-engeli esembindini.
